author: nickyeow

english.text: Water becomes solid when it freezes.

jyutping: seoi2 git3 zo2 bing1 zau6 wui5 bin3 zou6 gu3 tai2。
text: 水結咗冰就會變做固體。

author: nickyeow

english.text: He worked day and night so that he might become rich.

jyutping: keoi5 soeng2 zou6 jau5 cin2 lou2，so2 ji5 zau6 jau4 ziu1 dou3 maan5 hai6 gam2 zou6 je5。
text: 佢想做有錢佬，所以就由朝到晚係噉做嘢。

author: nickyeow

english.text: The sushi at this shop tastes good.

jyutping: ni1 gaan1 pou3 tau2 di1 sau6 si1 hou2 hou2 sik6。
text: 呢間舖頭啲壽司好好食。

author: nickyeow

english.text: It seems like there's no money left.

jyutping: tai2 lai4 hou2 ci5 mou5 saai3 cin2 lo1 wo3。

author: nickyeow

english.text: It's OK with me if it's OK with you.

jyutping: jyu4 gwo2 nei5 mou5 so2 wai6，ngo5 dou1 mou5 so2 wai6。
text: 如果你冇所謂，我都冇所謂。

author: nickyeow

english.text: We still have plenty of time left.

jyutping: ngo5 dei6 zung6 jau5 daai6 baa2 si4 gaan1 sing6。

author: nickyeow

english.text: She breaks something every time she cleans the room.

jyutping: keoi5 zap1 can1 fong4 dou1 jiu3 daa2 laan6 gam3 di1 je5 sin1 zi3 on1 lok6。
text: 佢執親房都要打爛咁啲嘢先至安樂。

english.text: There are only two days left.

author: nickyeow

english.text: How come you're not going to buy a blue one?

jyutping: nei5 dim2 gaai2 m4 maai5 laam4 sik1 go2 go3 ge3？
text: 你點解唔買藍色嗰個嘅？

author: nickyeow
jyutping: ngo5 soeng2 lau4 hai2 dou3 aa3。

author: thesilhouette

english.text: I don't want to buy this kind of car.

jyutping: ngo5 m4 soeng2 maai5 ne1 fun2 ce1。

english.text: For 21 days in August, more than 10,000 athletes from around the world will compete in the Summer Olympic Games in Beijing. While they come in pursuit of personal dreams, they will also represent their respective countries. For spectators and supporters from the more than 200 countries participating, the Olympics are a chance to cheer for their countrymen and women. For the athletes themselves, national pride is a powerful motivator.

jyutping: hai2 baat3 jyut6 ge3 21 jat6，lai4 zi6 sai3 gaai3 gok3 dei6 ge3 ciu1 gwo3 jat1 maan6 ming4 wan6 dung6 jyun4 zoeng1 wui5 hai2 bak1 ging1 caam1 gaa1 haa6 gwai3 ou3 wan6 wui2，keoi5 dei6 hai2 zeoi1 kau4 go3 jan4 mung6 soeng2 ge3 tung4 si4，jik6 dou1 wui5 doi6 biu2 keoi5 dei6 gok3 zi6 ge3 gwok3 gaa1，wai6 ciu1 gwo3 200 meng2 ge3 gun1 zung3 tung4 zi1 ci4 ze2 ji4 zin3 caam1 gaa1 ge3 gwok3 gaa1，ou3 wan6 wui2 hai6 jat1 go3 wai6 keoi5 dei6 ge3 tung4 baau1 tung4 neoi5 sing3 gaa1 jau2 ge3 gei1 wui6 deoi3 jyu1 wan6 dung6 jyun4 bun2 san1 lai4 gong2，gwok3 gaa1 giu1 ngou6 hai6 jat1 go3 koeng4 daai6 ge3 dung6 lik6。
text: 喺八月嘅21日，嚟自世界各地嘅超過一萬名運動員將會喺北京參加夏季奧運會，佢哋喺追求個人夢想嘅同時，亦都會代表佢哋各自嘅國家，為超過200名嘅觀眾同支持者而戰參加嘅國家，奧運會係一個為佢哋嘅同胞同女性加油嘅機會對於運動員本身嚟講，國家驕傲係一個強大嘅動力。

author: Davidgo5867

english.text: I talked to Greg the Filipino this morning in Starbucks café. Greg was drinking Mocha and I a Passion Tango iced tea. I saw that seemingly "Greek" muscleman again, in and out of the café with his coffee. "Ang laki! (So big!)," I said to Greg. His body is like a Greek god sculpture. (I am not really sure if he is Greek, but I heard him talking in his cellphone in a language that sounded Greek to me.) I took my second walk in the grey-sky morning: At Yummy Slice pizzeria, Sachet the Gujarati vendor and Tharsan the Sri Lankan owner were there, as I was drinking my grey-can Diet Coke. At the Subway sandwitcheria, I got a Turkey Ranch "Snackwich" with spinach, tomatoes, fried onions, cucumbers, and honey mustard sauce. Simran the Punjabi Sikh was my vendor. She talked about the coming Lohri Festival in January for Punjabis. It has to do with celebrating with bonfires and honouring childbirth. I greeted Don the head-shaven white man at Starbucks café, where I was eating almonds. Today is the 9th of December of 2024.

jyutping: ngo5 gam1 ziu1 hai2 sing1 baa1 hak1 gaa3 fe1 gun2 tung4 fei1 leot6 ban1 jan4 Greg king1 gai2。ngo5 jau6 gin3 dou2 go2 go3 hon3 ci5「hei1 laap6」ge3 gei1 juk6 naam4，hai2 gaa3 fe1 teng1 jap6 min6 ceot1 jap6，jam2 gan2 gaa3 fe1，ngo5 tung4 gaak3 leoi4 gaak3 gong2，keoi5 ge3 san1 tai2 hou2 ci5 jat1 go3 hei1 laap6 san4 diu1 sou3 gam2（ngo5 m4 taai3 hang2 ding6 keoi5 hai6 mai6 hei1 laap6 jan4，daan6 ngo5 teng1 dou3 keoi5 jung6 jat1 zung2 deoi3 ngo5 lai4 gong2 hou2 ci5 hei1 laap6 man4 ge3 jyu5 jin4。） ngo5 hai2 fui1 am3 ge3 ziu1 zou2 haang4 zo2 dai6 ji6 ci3：hai2 Yummy Slice bou2 beng2 dim3，gu2 gat1 laai1 dak6 siu2 faan2 Sachet tung4 si1 lei5 laan4 kaa1 lou5 baan2 Tharsan dou1 hai2 dou6，dong1 si4 ngo5 jam2 gan2 ngo5 ge3 fui1 gun3 gin6 ji4 ho2 lok6。hai2 dei6 tit3 saam1 man4 zi6 dim3，ngo5 lo2 zo2 go3 fo2 gai1 muk6 coeng4「siu2 sik6」 , jau5 bo1 coi3、faan1 ke2、zaa3 joeng4 cung1、ceng1 gwaa1 tung4 fung1 mat6 gaai3 mut6 zoeng3。pong4 ze1 pou2 sek3 hak1 gaau3 tou4 Simran hai6 ngo5 ge3 siu2 faan2。keoi5 gong2 dou3 lai4 gan2 ge3 jat1 jyut6 lo4 lei5 zit3，hai6 pong4 ze1 pou2 jan4 ge3 si6。ni1 go3 tung4 jung6 zuk1 gwong1 hing3 zuk1 tung4 hing3 zuk1 fan1 min5 jau5 gwaan1。ngo5 hai2 sing1 baa1 hak1 gaa3 fe1 gun2 dou6 tung4 go3 tai3 tau4 ge3 baak6 jan4 Don daa2 ziu1 fu1，dong1 si4 ngo5 hai2 dou6 sik6 gan2 hang6 jan4。gam1 jat6 hai6 2024 nin4 12 jyut6 9 hou6。
text: 我今朝喺星巴克咖啡館同菲律賓人 Greg 傾偈。我又見到嗰個看似「希臘」嘅肌肉男，喺咖啡廳入面出入，飲緊咖啡，我同格雷格講，佢嘅身體好似一個希臘神雕塑噉（我唔太肯定佢係咪希臘人，但我聽到佢用一種對我嚟講好似希臘文嘅語言。） 我喺灰暗嘅朝早行咗第二次：喺 Yummy Slice 簿餅店，古吉拉特小販 Sachet 同斯里蘭卡老闆 Tharsan 都喺度，當時我飲緊我嘅灰罐健怡可樂。喺地鐵三文治店，我攞咗個火雞牧場「小食」 , 有菠菜、蕃茄、炸洋蔥、青瓜同蜂蜜芥末醬。旁遮普錫克教徒 Simran 係我嘅小販。佢講到嚟緊嘅一月羅里節，係旁遮普人嘅事。呢個同用燭光慶祝同慶祝分娩有關。我喺星巴克咖啡館度同個剃頭嘅白人 Don 打招呼，當時我喺度食緊杏仁。今日係2024年12月9號。
